legalActions.narration: Hands dealt. The dealer shows one card. Hit or stand.

instructions: You get two cards face down, the dealer gets one up and one down. Hit to draw; the table detects a bust or a 21 on its own and ends your turn. Stand passes play to the dealer. Ask the agent to play the dealer with score_hand (aceAlt 11, bustOver 21) and settle with award_chips.
